title: Locally Private Estimation of the Optimal Treatment Value over Holder Classes
banked_reason: Sound preliminary bracket leaves the matched all-channel NI/SI frontier open; exact logarithms, interaction gains, and reverse honest-length/root-risk comparability remain unresolved. Independent validity gate confirms below-floor partial delivery.
gap_reasons: The preliminary-bracket theorem bounds root MSE and honest expected length between N^{-gamma}L^{gamma-1} and (NL)^{-gamma}, leaving a factor L^{1/(beta+1)} unresolved.
Exact logarithms, interaction gains, and two-sided comparability of honest length with root minimax risk therefore remain unanswered in sharp-frontier.
The unresolved quantitative comparison and limited methodological advance make this a specialized contribution and constrain the projected paper score to 5.4.
proof_attempt_summary: The solver established a sound one-scale original-record private rate bracket, finite honest intervals, consistency boundary, and exclusion of private-parametric precision on the full class. The necessary logarithm, interaction benefit, and sharp risk/length equivalence remain open; a dyadic Jensen-gap identity does not supply the missing multilevel covariance or correlated-prior certificates. Two independent managed validity judgments confirmed disclosed below-contract incompleteness rather than laundering; retry requires new proof evidence, not an unchanged rerun. No Lean formalization was launched, and no substrate was promoted.
tldr: The unrestricted optimal treatment value is a population mean plus an integrated absolute treatment contrast. The cusp persists at exact and shrinking ties within a fixed uniform Hölder class. The central question determines complete original-record locally private NI and SI squared-error and finite globally honest connected-length frontiers, including every logarithm and any interaction gain. Continuous legal bump priors and exact message moments support a preliminary bracket to verify. An envelope-aware multiscale correction or richer legal priors must close its spatial logarithm gap before the field contribution is established.
gap: Han--Jiao--Mukherjee includes uniform Hölder regularity in its Gaussian upper result but excludes it from the matching lower theorem; its prior-support obstruction is explicit. Private smooth-functional transfers require differentiability that the unrestricted welfare cusp lacks.
fill: The research target is a matching spatial functional risk and honest-length frontier derived from original-record private mechanisms and uniformly supported alternatives. The unrestricted NI public coins and SI histories are part of every converse. The preliminary bracket supplies a falsifiable starting point rather than the field contribution.
